sections.title: Article 1 General Provisions
items: These Terms of Use (hereinafter, the “Terms”) apply to all activities of users in connection with their use of the AI character chat service “AiKano” (hereinafter, the “Service”) provided by the operator.
These Terms set forth the conditions for using the Service. Users must use the Service in accordance with these Terms.
By using the Service, users are deemed to have agreed to all provisions set forth in these Terms.

sections.title: Article 2: Amendments to These Terms of Use
items: We may amend these Terms of Use from time to time without obtaining the user's consent.
If we amend these Terms of Use, we will promptly post the amended version on the Service.
The amended Terms of Use will take effect when posted on the Service.

sections.title: Article 3: Purpose of the Service
items: The Service is an interactive entertainment service provided by the Company to users, featuring conversations with virtual characters using artificial intelligence (AI) technology.

All characters appearing in the Service (hereinafter referred to as “AI Characters”) are fictional and are not real people. Responses in the Service are generated by AI and the Company’s response system. Staff may be involved in some interactions to improve the quality of responses.

The Service is not intended to facilitate interaction between users and does not constitute an “Internet Dating Service Business” as defined under the Act on Regulation of Soliciting Children by Using Internet Dating Services.

sections.title: Article 4: Eligibility
items: This service is available only to users aged 18 or older.
High school students may not use this service, even if they are 18 or older.
By starting to use this service, users represent and warrant to us that they are 18 or older and are not high school students.
If we discover that a user is under 18, we will immediately suspend their use of the service.

sections.title: Article 5: Notices from the Company
items: The Company will notify users of necessary matters from time to time by posting them on the Service, sending emails, or by any other method the Company deems appropriate.
The notices referred to in the preceding paragraph will take effect when the Company posts them on the Service or sends them by email or other means.

sections.title: Article 6: Account Management
items: Users are responsible for managing their account information.
We accept no liability for any damages resulting from unauthorized use of an account.
Users may not maintain multiple accounts or transfer or lend their accounts to others.

sections.title: Article 7: Usage Fees
items: Each text chat message costs 10 points (equivalent to ¥100).
The price per point is ¥10 (tax included). Bonus points are awarded when you purchase points in bulk. For details about purchase plans, please see the Points Purchase page in this service.
You will receive 50 free points when you sign up (enough for your first 5 messages). You will also receive a daily login bonus of 20 points, valid for 30 days.
Estimated point costs: text chat: 10 points; premium content (such as videos): the price displayed for each item. The number of points required may change without notice.

Monthly subscriptions are available for the Standard Plan (¥2,980/month, 300 messages) and the Premium Plan (¥4,980/month, 500 messages). After you exceed the monthly message limit, you can continue using either plan for 5 points per message.

Monthly subscriptions renew automatically on the same date each month. You can cancel at any time from My Page. After cancellation, you can continue using the service until the end of the current billing period.
30-day passes are also available via convenience store payment and PayPay (Standard: ¥2,980; Premium: ¥4,980). 30-day passes do not renew automatically.
Due to the digital nature of point purchases and 30-day passes, purchases are non-refundable.
Purchased points do not expire. However, points awarded as login bonuses or other benefits expire 30 days after they are granted.
When you close your account with this service, all points you own will be deleted.
You are responsible for any communication charges and other costs required to use this service.
When using paid services, you will not be charged any additional fees, including interest, administrative fees, or late fees.

This service is for entertainment purposes. Purchasing points gives you the right to use digital content in exchange for payment. Points are not intended for investment, profit-making, or exchange for cash.

sections.title: Article 8: About AI Characters (Important)
items: All AI characters featured in this service are fictional and have no connection whatsoever to any real person, organization, character, or other entity.

Responses in this service are generated by AI and our response systems. To improve response quality, staff may be involved in some interactions. We do not guarantee the accuracy, appropriateness, or truthfulness of any response.
Because AI character responses are generated probabilistically based on training data, they may differ from users’ expectations and may contain contradictory or inaccurate information.
Users must not rely on AI character responses as real-world advice or as professional medical, legal, financial, or other advice.

Conversations with AI characters are for entertainment purposes. We accept no responsibility if use of this service causes a user to develop emotional dependence or negatively affects their real life.
AI characters are portrayed as fictional adults aged 18 or older. Characters whose age is not explicitly stated are also portrayed as adults aged 18 or older.

sections.title: Article 9: Prohibited Conduct
sections.preamble: Users must not engage in any of the following conduct when using the Service:
items: Violating these Terms of Use
Violating any laws or regulations, or public order and morals
Engaging in activities for commercial, affiliate marketing, advertising, solicitation, or similar purposes
Requesting that an AI character be given a setting or description that evokes a person under the age of 18
Generating or requesting child pornography, child abuse, incest (that evokes real family relationships), or impersonations of real people (such as entertainers or public figures)
Generating or eliciting content through an AI character that encourages crime, suicide, self-harm, drug use, or other illegal or harmful conduct
Redistributing, reselling, or publishing AI-generated content obtained through the Service to third parties
Misrepresenting an AI character’s response as something said by a real person
Infringing, or potentially infringing, the copyrights, trademarks, or other intellectual property rights of other users, third parties, or the Company
Infringing the property, privacy, rights of likeness, or publicity rights of other users, third parties, or the Company
Discriminating against, defaming, or slandering other users, third parties, or the Company, or harming their reputation or credibility
Interfering with the operation of the Service by the Company
Using the Service by impersonating a third party
Attempting to gain unauthorized access to the Service, reverse engineer it, or extract its AI models
Using responses from the Service as training data to train other AI models
A single user holding multiple accounts
Multiple users sharing the same account
Transferring or lending an account for the Service
Encouraging or facilitating any of the conduct listed above
Any other conduct that the Company deems inappropriate
sections.suffix: If the Company confirms that a user has engaged in any of the prohibited conduct set out above, it may suspend the user’s access to the Service or terminate their membership without prior notice.

sections.title: Article 10: Account Withdrawal
items: Users may terminate their use of the Service and withdraw from it at any time in accordance with these Terms and the procedures established by the Company.
You can submit a withdrawal request in Settings on your My Page.
If there are no issues with the user's account, the withdrawal will be processed immediately after the request is submitted.
If a user has not logged in for a certain period of time (180 days or more), the user will be deemed to have withdrawn from the Service.
When a user withdraws from the Service, they will lose all rights as a member, including the right to use the Service and the right to receive information through the Service's notification feature.
Upon withdrawal from the Service, all points held by the user will be deleted. Purchased points are non-refundable.
No fees or other charges apply to withdrawal.
If a user engages in any prohibited conduct set forth in Article 9, the Company may withdraw the user from the Service without prior notice.
The Company shall bear no responsibility for any damages incurred by a user as a result of being removed from the Service.

sections.title: Article 11: Handling of Chat Data
items: We may store and analyze chats between users and AI characters to improve the service, enhance the quality of AI responses, detect misuse, and comply with applicable laws and regulations.
We may use chat data to improve the service and train AI after processing it so that individuals cannot be identified.

If illegal activity (such as requests for child sexual abuse material or encouragement of criminal activity) is detected, we may preserve the relevant chat logs as evidence and provide them to law enforcement authorities as necessary.
Users enter any personal information (such as their real name, address, or phone number) at their own responsibility. We are not liable for any damages arising from such information.

sections.title: Article 12: Advertising
items: We may provide users with advertisements from us and advertisers through the Service.
We do not guarantee the content of any services provided to users by advertisers, nor are we responsible for any results thereof.
You agree to hold us harmless from any loss or damage arising from your use of advertisements or any actions resulting therefrom.

sections.title: Article 13: Deletion of Information
items: If the Company confirms that a user has engaged in any prohibited conduct set forth in Article 9 of these Terms of Use, the Company will delete information relating to the violation without prior notice to the user.
If a user inquires about a deletion made pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the Company will have no obligation to explain the reasons for the deletion.

sections.title: Article 14: Disclaimer
items: The Company makes no guarantees of any kind regarding the accuracy, reliability, usefulness, legality, currency, or other aspects of information provided to users through the Service, including responses from AI characters.
The Company shall have no liability for any mental, physical, or financial harm suffered by users as a result of AI character responses.
The Service is for entertainment purposes only. AI characters are not a substitute for real-life relationships, medical, legal, or financial advice, or any other form of professional advice.
The Company shall not be liable if users develop a psychological dependence as a result of using the Service. Where appropriate, users are encouraged to consult a qualified professional.
The Company shall have no liability for any consequences resulting from users’ use of the Service, or from any malfunction or interruption of the Service.
Users understand and agree that AI technology is still developing and that they may not receive the responses they expect.

sections.title: Article 15: Termination of the Service
items: We may, after notifying users, discontinue the Service or any part of it at any time.

sections.title: Article 16: Suspension of the Service
sections.preamble: We may temporarily suspend the Service without prior notice to users in any of the following cases:
items: When necessary for the maintenance or construction of facilities used for the Service
When a failure occurs in facilities used for the Service
When a failure occurs in an AI foundation model (external API services such as OpenAI or Anthropic)
When we determine that a temporary suspension of the Service is necessary due to other operational or technical issues

sections.title: Article 17: Handling of Personal Information
items: We will appropriately protect users’ personal information and comply with the “Privacy Policy” separately posted on this Service.

The ownership of copyright in content generated by AI through the Service (including chat content and generated images) shall be determined separately by the Company. Users may not use such content for commercial purposes, redistribute it, or distribute derivative works.
All rights to the names, settings, visuals, and other elements of AI characters belong to the Company.

sections.title: Article 19: Claims for Damages
items: If a user violates these Terms of Use or uses the Service unlawfully, thereby causing damage to us, we will seek appropriate damages.

sections.title: Article 20: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
items: These Terms of Use shall be governed by the laws of Japan.

In the event of any dispute arising in connection with the use of the Service, the parties agree that the Osaka District Court or the Osaka Summary Court, as applicable based on the amount in controversy, shall have agreed exclusive jurisdiction as the court of first instance.

sections.title: Article 21: Age Verification
items: Because this service may contain adult content, it may be used only by individuals who are at least 18 years old and are not high school students.
When beginning to use the service, users must declare that they are at least 18 years old.
If we determine that a user is under 18 based on information provided by the user, their usage, or other reasonable means, we may suspend their use of the service and delete their account.
If we discover that a user is under 18, we will not refund any purchased points, except when a contract is cancelled under the rules for contracts with minors.

sections.title: Article 22: Miscellaneous
items: If any issue arises between the User and the Company, both parties shall consult in good faith and endeavor to resolve it.
Any matters concerning the use of this Service that are not provided for in these Terms of Use shall be governed by rules separately established by the Company.
